entries.text: Features api: add Google-managed data controls for Google Cloud projects api: add Google-managed data controls for user profiles api: add support for compliance review cases, notices, and items Bug Fixes client: honor proxy and trust_env when proxy variables are set DefaultHttpxClient and DefaultAsyncHttpxClient read HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY and NO_PROXY even when the caller passed proxy= or trust_env=False, and the variables won. Now proxy= is used for every request and the variables are not read, and trust_env=False ignores them, as in plain httpx2. What you may notice: with proxy= set, a host listed in NO_PROXY used to be reached directly and now goes through your proxy. To keep a host off the proxy, pass mounts={"all://that.host": None}. Chores docs: drop the provisional naming note from the Google Cloud client README docs: name both causes of the tool use limit error docs: update example workspace and API key IDs Documentation show what enum values mean

entries.text: Features api: add the image_dimensions_too_large error code Bug Fixes bedrock: send the user profile ID in the request body Amazon Bedrock reads user_profile_id from the request body and ignores the anthropic-user-profile-id header, so a profile ID given to AnthropicBedrock or AsyncAnthropicBedrock was not applied. Both clients now move it into the body of Messages requests and no longer send the header. A user_profile_id already in the body takes priority over the header. Some models on Bedrock do not support user profiles. A request to one of them with a profile ID now fails with a 400 error; before, the ID was ignored. Leave the ID off requests to those models. Chores docs: clarify billing_policy in batches and two billing errors
